comments.body:
Stats:

+1 Geography
5k fame to equip

This can be sold from an NPC named "Geographer" within company colonies, who will appear if enough Colony immigrant quests are completed. Any colony can have this NPC if the conditions are met, so you can visit another company's colony if your own company's colony (if it has one) lacks the Geographer NPC.
